AboutUsPage.title: About Us
AboutUsPage.description: The Department of Animal Breeding and Product Quality Assessment carries out research and teaching in animal breeding and the quality assessment of animal products.
AboutUsPage.overview: The department is part of the Faculty of Veterinary Medicine and Animal Sciences at Poznań University of Life Sciences. It works on the breeding and husbandry of farm and fur animals and on the quality assessment of milk, meat and other animal products, and its staff teach on the faculty's degree programmes.
AboutUsPage.teamsIntro: Research and teaching are carried out by teams with different specialisations:
AboutUsPage.workText: The full, searchable list of the staff's scientific publications is on the <link>Scientific publications</link> page. Selected recent publications and projects are also listed on each team's page.
AboutUsPage.contactText: Contact details and consultation hours of the <head>head of department</head>, and how to reach the <contact>department office</contact>, are on separate pages.
AboutUsPage.teamsMore: Team members and the department's management: <link>Department structure</link>.

AccessibilityPage.title: Accessibility statement
AccessibilityPage.metaDescription: Accessibility statement for the website of the Department of Animal Breeding and Product Quality Assessment, Poznań University of Life Sciences: compliance status, accessibility features and how to report problems.
AccessibilityPage.intro: <org>Poznań University of Life Sciences</org> is committed to making its website accessible in accordance with the Polish Act of 4 April 2019 on the digital accessibility of websites and mobile applications of public sector bodies. This accessibility statement applies to the website of the <site>Department of Animal Breeding and Product Quality Assessment</site>.
AccessibilityPage.updatedLabel: Date of the last major update
AccessibilityPage.status: This website is partially compliant with the Act of 4 April 2019 on the digital accessibility of websites and mobile applications of public sector bodies due to the non-compliances listed below.
AccessibilityPage.issueAlt: Some photos in the news section may lack alternative text in some language versions.
AccessibilityPage.issueDocuments: Some documents available for download in the student zone (PDF, DOC) may have been published in a format that is not digitally accessible.
AccessibilityPage.issueMap: The map showing the department's location is provided by Google Maps and is not fully accessible. The address is also given on the page as text.
AccessibilityPage.issueLanguages: Not all content is available in Ukrainian and Russian. Articles displayed in another language are marked as such.
AccessibilityPage.assessment: This statement was prepared on the basis of a self-assessment carried out by the public body.
AccessibilityPage.featureContrast: high contrast and text size controls in the menu (your browser remembers the settings);
AccessibilityPage.featureSkip: a “Skip to main content” link at the top of the page, shown when you press Tab;
AccessibilityPage.featureKeyboard: the whole website can be used with a keyboard;
AccessibilityPage.featureMotion: content is visible without JavaScript, and animations are turned off when your system is set to reduce motion;
AccessibilityPage.featureLanguages: language versions: Polish, English, Ukrainian and Russian.
AccessibilityPage.contactIntro: If you encounter accessibility problems on this website, please contact us. You can also use these details to request information in an accessible form or to request that accessibility be ensured.
AccessibilityPage.person: Office of the Department of Animal Breeding and Product Quality Assessment
AccessibilityPage.procedureRequest: Everyone has the right to request that a website or any of its elements be made digitally accessible. You may also request that information be provided in an alternative way, for example by reading out a document that is not digitally accessible or describing the content of a photo. The request should include the requester's details, the website or element it concerns and a way to contact the requester. If you need the information in an alternative form, please specify the form that suits you.
AccessibilityPage.procedureDeadline: The public body handles the request promptly and no later than within 7 days. If this is not possible, it informs the requester without delay when the request will be fulfilled, which may not be later than 2 months from the date of the request. If digital accessibility cannot be ensured, the public body may offer an alternative way of accessing the information.
AccessibilityPage.procedureComplaint: If the public body refuses to ensure accessibility or to provide an alternative way of accessing the information, the requester may file a complaint about the digital accessibility of the website or its element.
AccessibilityPage.procedureOmbudsman: Once this procedure has been completed, you may also submit an application to the <link>Commissioner for Human Rights</link> (Rzecznik Praw Obywatelskich).
AccessibilityPage.architecture: The department is located in the Poznań University of Life Sciences building at 50 Szydłowska St., Poznań. Information on the physical accessibility of the university's buildings, including entrances, lifts, toilets and parking spaces for people with disabilities, is available on the <link>university website</link>.
AccessibilityPage.apps: The department does not provide any mobile applications.

PrivacyPage.title: Privacy policy
PrivacyPage.metaDescription: What data the website of the Department of Animal Breeding and Product Quality Assessment collects, which cookies it uses and what rights visitors have.
PrivacyPage.intro: This page explains what information about visitors the website of the Department of Animal Breeding and Product Quality Assessment collects and what it is used for. In short: the site has no log-in, no forms, no analytics or advertising, and does not track visitors.
PrivacyPage.controller: The controller of personal data is {university}, {address}. For matters concerning this website, please contact the department office: <mail>{email}</mail>, phone {phone}.
PrivacyPage.dpoLink: The university has appointed a data protection officer, whose contact details are on the <link>university website</link>.
PrivacyPage.dpoEmail: The university's data protection officer can be contacted at <mail>{email}</mail>.
PrivacyPage.logs: Like any web server, the server running this site may record technical data about requests in its logs: IP address, date and time, the page requested and information about the browser. This data is used only to keep the site working and secure. Text typed into the search box is logged only if it looks like an attack. The data is not used to identify visitors and is not shared with anyone, except where required by law.
PrivacyPage.logsBasis: The legal basis is Article 6(1)(e) GDPR (a task carried out in the public interest: running the website of a public university). Logs are kept only as long as needed for these purposes.
PrivacyPage.storageIntro: The site stores in your browser only what is needed for the features you use. It uses no analytics, advertising or third-party cookies. Storing information that is strictly necessary for a service the user asks for requires no consent, which is why the site shows no cookie banner.
PrivacyPage.localePurpose: The chosen language version. Set only when it differs from your browser's language.
PrivacyPage.untilCleared: until you clear the site's data in the browser
PrivacyPage.storageNote: Local storage data is never sent to the server. You can delete all of this information in your browser settings; the site will then use its default settings.
PrivacyPage.map: On the Contact page the Google map loads only after you click “Show map”. Only then does your browser connect to Google's servers, which receive data such as your IP address and may set their own cookies. Google is responsible for that processing, as described in the <link>Google privacy policy</link>. Without the click, no data is sent to Google.
PrivacyPage.other: Fonts, images and all other files of the site come from the same server, without external services. Links to other sites, such as the university or the faculty, lead to websites with their own privacy policies.
PrivacyPage.messages: If you write to the department, your e-mail address and message are used to reply and are handled according to the university's rules.
PrivacyPage.rights: Within the limits set by the GDPR, you have the right to access your data, to have it corrected, erased or its processing restricted, and the right to object. You may also lodge a complaint with the President of the Personal Data Protection Office (<link>uodo.gov.pl</link>).
